item.storymod.dawn_star.desc: Warm, like a morning that almost never came.
item.storymod.keeper_gear.desc: Still warm. Smells of oil and amethyst.
item.storymod.white_pearl.desc: Warm, though it should be cold. Everything feels a little closer around it.
item.storymod.white_pearl.effect: Sneak + use on a block: lift it. Use while holding one: set it down. Use in the air: shadow step.
item.storymod.twilight_amulet.desc: Warm in the dark, cold in the light.
item.storymod.twilight_amulet.effect: Use: shadows hide you and speed you up. Faster in darkness.
item.storymod.keeper_wrench.effect: Use with a damaged item in the other hand: repairs it for a copper ingot. Held: faster digging.
item.storymod.order_medallion.desc: A sign of the Order of Zenith.
item.storymod.white_pearl.effect2: Carried or worn: sometimes slips away from arrows, ender pearls do not hurt, faster in darkness.
